concept.zh: 两个带笑脸、相扣的聊天气泡，呼应 c 与 d，表达规划审查端和执行端之间的连接与协作。
concept.en: Two smiling, interlocking chat bubbles suggest c and d, expressing the connection and cooperation between planning/review and execution.

generation_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original mascot logo mark for cd-connect, an open-source local bridge connecting a planning/review AI client with an existing execution host.
Primary request: design a very cute, memorable, polished symbol expressing two agents connecting and cooperating.
Subject: two plump, rounded chat-bubble loop shapes snugly interlocked into ONE compact emblem, subtly suggesting a lowercase c and d without relying on literal typography. Give each loop a tiny friendly face with two simple dot eyes and a gentle smile. The two shapes should feel like a pair of little buddies working together, with balanced open negative space and an unmistakable connection.
Style/medium: refined flat vector-like logo artwork, clean confident contours, rounded geometry, charming and understated; not a detailed cartoon illustration. Strong silhouette that remains recognizable at small avatar sizes.
Color palette: the project's established dark blue #254e88 paired with a soft blue-gray #b9cdea; small white facial details where needed. Use opaque flat fills for the emblem.
Composition/framing: a single centered icon on a square canvas with balanced modest padding, entire symbol visible, no surrounding scene, no variants, no presentation board.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background, including all open negative spaces.
Text: no text, no lettering, no wordmark, no tagline.
Constraints: original design, independent of OpenAI or DeepSeek logos; minimal shapes, crisp edges, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no sticker border, no decorative props, no watermark. Aim for warm friendliness and technical simplicity.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: the provided cd-connect logo image.
Change only production cleanup: retain exactly the same two interlocking rounded c/d chat-bubble buddies, their cute dot eyes and smiles, overall silhouette, relative placement, and blue color identities. Remove every stray pixel, colored speck, white fringe, ragged edge, interior-hole noise, and faint detached mark. Make the two bodies clean opaque flat fills, dark blue #254e88 and pale blue-gray #b9cdea, with simple white/dark-blue facial details. Keep the friendly character and generous padding.
The entire surrounding background AND both open interior holes must be genuine transparent alpha, perfectly clean with no visible residue. Edges should be smooth, sharp, antialiased without a light halo. No gradients, texture, shadows, background, sticker outline, text, extra symbols, or added details. A polished standalone original logo icon, not a mockup or presentation.
